facts: The real API journey published FORMULA, SUMMARY, CALCULATED, LOOKUP and AGGREGATE snapshots with typed metadata and rejected an indirect dependency cycle as SCHEMA_CYCLE.
The complete backend reactor passed 40 tests with zero failures, errors or skips on JDK 21.
Flyway V4.10.0 passed populated MySQL 8.4 replay and empty MySQL 8.0 replay while preserving the 30-table runtime boundary.
Database-first generation covered 30 un_module_ tables and produced the same 150-file tree hash on two consecutive runs.
Remaining work is bounded to independent DBA/test evidence assembly, task state transition and framework validation.
